finding_F108_LOUNGE_ACCESS_IS_INDIRECTLY.claim: Lounge access sits at Silver — the first tier above entry — and Qpoints, the currency that reaches Silver, are sold by Qatar Airways.
finding_F108_LOUNGE_ACCESS_IS_INDIRECTLY.the_chain: F-105 established 'Buy Qpoints' exists as a named product. This capture establishes lounge access is a Silver benefit and Silver costs 150 Qpoints in 12 months. Therefore lounge access is reachable BY PURCHASE, without flying the qualifying volume.
finding_F108_LOUNGE_ACCESS_IS_INDIRECTLY.confidence: Verified that both facts hold. The INFERENCE that one can buy enough Qpoints to reach Silver is Inferred — purchase limits and whether bought Qpoints count toward tier qualification were NOT captured, and many programmes explicitly exclude purchased points from tier progression.
finding_F108_LOUNGE_ACCESS_IS_INDIRECTLY.what_would_settle_it: Open /en-gb/Privilege-Club/buy-qpoints.html and read whether purchased Qpoints count toward tier status. This is the single most important unopened page on this competitor.

why_it_matters_for_BUSINESS_GOAL_5.the_goal: Increase usage of airport services such as lounges and Fast Track
why_it_matters_for_BUSINESS_GOAL_5.F-53 found: Iberia bundles airport services with Business class — no price, no purchase path
why_it_matters_for_BUSINESS_GOAL_5.F-54 raised: if they come free with premium cabins, the market for SELLING them is economy passengers, a business the scenario has not scoped
why_it_matters_for_BUSINESS_GOAL_5.this_capture_adds: Qatar offers a THIRD route: lounge access as a loyalty-tier benefit, with the tier currency purchasable. Not a lounge pass, not a fare-class entitlement — a status product. That is a genuinely different commercial model and it is the closest thing to an answer business goal 5 has received.

finding_F109_THREE_CURRENCIES_IN_ONE_PRO.claim: Privilege Club runs three distinct currencies.

the_three.Avios: spendable — redeemed for flights and rewards (F-105: purchasable)
the_three.Qcredits: utility — 'to redeem for upgrades, excess baggage and much more', granted 40 at Gold

the_full_comparison_across_four_programm.Booking.com Genius: 0 currencies — a discount tier gated by booking count
the_full_comparison_across_four_programm.Iberia Club: 2 currencies (Avios spendable, Elite Points status), Avios earnable off-platform
the_full_comparison_across_four_programm.Qatar Privilege Club: 3 currencies, two of them purchasable, plus a paid membership tier above the free programme

finding_F109_THREE_CURRENCIES_IN_ONE_PRO.for_luma: Complexity scales with the operator's ability to monetise it. Luma at ideation has no basis for three currencies and, per F-58, its user starts at zero on all of them. The transferable observation is NOT the currency design — it is that every one of these programmes measures the same thing: money spent with the operator. None measures whether the traveller had a good trip.

finding_F110_FOUR_OF_FOUR_ON_FIRST_TIMER.claim: Four loyalty programmes, four full-text searches, zero mentions of a first-time traveller.
finding_F110_FOUR_OF_FOUR_ON_FIRST_TIMER.evidence: This page searched for 'first-time', 'new member', 'beginner', 'just starting' — no match. Same null recorded for Genius (F-02), One Key (F-18) and Iberia Club (F-60).
finding_F110_FOUR_OF_FOUR_ON_FIRST_TIMER.status: Four of four, across two intermediaries and two airlines — two distinct business models and two regulatory regimes. This is now the most robust repeated null in the round.
finding_F110_FOUR_OF_FOUR_ON_FIRST_TIMER.the_reading: Loyalty programmes are built for the traveller who already travels. That is not an oversight; it is what loyalty means. Luma's stated primary user is definitionally outside every one of them, and no observed competitor has tried to solve that.

retention_mechanics_note.observation: Every tier above Burgundy has a RETENTION threshold lower than its qualification threshold — Silver qualifies at 150 and retains at 135; Gold qualifies at 300 and retains at 270.
retention_mechanics_note.why_it_is_interesting: The programme is easier to keep than to reach. That is a deliberate anti-churn design and the only observed loyalty mechanic that reduces pressure on an existing member rather than increasing it.
